caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical architectural structure, likely an interior wall, oriented vertically with ornate decorative elements. The color palette includes pastel greens, blues, reds, golds, and pinks. At the center top of the composition, a large cloud-like blue and grey shape encircles a yellow triangle with an eye at its center; this is surrounded by radiating gold and blue beams. Above this, the background features a vine of pink and blue flowers that extends horizontally. Flanking both sides at the top, there are two identical large urns with green finials, red and green vertical stripes, blue bases, and small blue handles, each situated on a rectangular pedestal. Beneath these urns, a frieze with alternating geometric and floral patterns runs horizontally, predominantly in gold, blue, red, and white hues. Below this frieze are four vertical Corinthian-style columns, two on each side, colored in blue, white, and red, separating the wall into three distinct vertical sections. Each outer section contains a large rectangular frame decorated with a red floral pattern on white, enclosing a blank yellowish space, and beneath each frame is a white and red decorative shelf. Above each frame, a circular medallion contains a bird motif, and red and green flower sprigs further embellish the panels. The central section features two smaller columns at the edges, a central green altar-like structure at the bottom decorated with gold stars, a pedestal with a red and white urn above it, and flanking rectangular panels with pink floral and green ornamentation. The lowest part of the wall incorporates a base molding in pink and yellow, with additional swirling yellow and blue patterns on a pale background. The drawing is set on a light-colored background with a thin beige border, and the artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Reredos and Wall Paintings
